Help.title: Help & Documentation
Help.subtitle: How MyDevTools works offline and how your data is protected

whatIs.title: What is MyDevTools?
whatIs.description: An offline developer workspace: a dashboard and 80+ tools that run entirely on your device.
whatIs.p1: MyDevTools runs fully offline. There is no account, no sign-in and no server — everything works on this device with no internet connection required. The sidebar lists every app; you can hide tools you do not use from
whatIs.p2: Some features use a master password (or global vault key) so that secrets like passwords and database connection strings are encrypted at rest on your device.

apps.intro: Open any tool from the sidebar or dashboard. Below is a short guide per app.
apps.generic: Use this tool from the sidebar for its dedicated workflow.

access.title: Offline access
access.description: How the app opens, and where your data lives.

items.activation: No account. Install the app and open it — there is nothing to register, activate or sign in to.
items.offline: No sessions. There is no sign-in, no token refresh and no periodic re-check, so the app keeps working with no internet connection.
items.storage: Local storage. All your data lives in an encrypted SQLCipher database on your device, keyed by a random key held in your operating system keychain.

encryption.title: Encryption you should know about
encryption.description: Client-side crypto for vault and sensitive connection data.
encryption.p1: For the password manager, environment manager, and NoSQL Explorer saved connections, the app uses the Web Crypto API:

items.kdf: PBKDF2 with SHA-256, 600,000 iterations, and a random salt derives a 256-bit key from your master password.
items.aes: AES-256-GCM encrypts payloads; a random 12-byte IV is used per encryption.
items.scope: The derived key stays in the app (non-extractable) and your master password never leaves your device. Only ciphertext and IVs are written to the local database.

encryption.warning: If you forget the master password, encrypted data cannot be recovered. Store it safely.

local.title: Locking & local data
local.body: Locking the vault clears in-memory secrets and master key material; your encrypted database stays on disk until you remove it. There is no sign-out—resetting app data or deleting the app is what clears everything, so keep your own backups of anything important.

items.masterPassword: Use a strong, unique master password for vault features.
items.backup: Your data lives only on this device—export or back it up regularly so you do not lose it if the device fails.
items.apiClient: Treat the API Client like any HTTP client: avoid pasting production secrets into shared environments unless you understand who can see them.
items.nosql: Database Explorer connects to databases you configure; use least-privilege users and network rules where possible.
items.json: JSON Formatter runs entirely on your device—still avoid pasting highly sensitive data on shared machines.
items.settings: Customize visible tools in Settings to keep the sidebar focused.
